The '''Dwarf Scroll III''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can drop from Blue, Purple, Red, Copper, Iron, or Tiger [[Slimes]], [[Bats|Lava Bats]], [[Lava Crab]]s, [[Squid Kid]]s, [[Shadow Brute]]s, [[Shadow Shaman]], [[Spider]]s, [[Metal Head]]s or [[Blue Squid]]s.

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].

Donating all 4 Dwarf Scrolls rewards the player with the [[Dwarvish Translation Guide]].

==Tailoring==
Dwarf Scroll III can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Gold Trimmed Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt222.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
One Dwarf Scroll III may be requested by [[Lava Eel]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 3 to 5.
